data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to perform UPI transactions through different apps in Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Android applications to query installed UPI apps and initiate payments using UPI IDs or account numbers. It handles responses and returns transaction statuses such as success, submission, or failure.
use_when: You are building an Android app that needs to accept UPI payments.
You want to allow users to pay using popular UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm.
avoid_when: You need iOS support, as this plugin is Android-only.
You are looking for non-UPI payment gateways.
strengths: Supports a wide range of verified and non-verified UPI apps on Android.
Provides custom exception handling for common transaction errors.
weaknesses: Some major apps like Google Pay and PhonePe may occasionally report errors like maximum limit exceeded.
data.setup_notes: Android only. Requires integrating with Android UPI intent handling.
